title: Ordinary quotient augmentation on a regular integral complex is invertible modulo the prime
statement: Let ell be prime, W a scheme, O an ordinary simultaneous cokernel presentation of the ell^(n+1) quotients of integral abelian sheaves on W_proet, RZ any total right-derived inverse limit with its comparison etaZ, and e any additive equivalence with sheaves of modules over the lifted integers. For every complex P whose positive prime-power multiplications are monic in every degree, the explicit ordinary augmentation [lem-sfb-integral-strict-augmentation], after applying e and derived reduction modulo ell, is an isomorphism. No simultaneous left-derived reduction I, arbitrary derived input, cone choice, or natural-transformation existence is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; algebraization.tex principal Koszul argument; proof of the regular-complex computation of the canonical strict augmentation

proof.text: Apply the unreduced normalized Milnor presentation to the specified ordinary augmentation. It supplies limiting product fans for the constant tower K and the principal derived quotient tower, distinguished Milnor triangles with vertices K and the actual image of RZ, and both squares for the actual augmentation, including the shifted boundary square.

The lifted prime is a nonzerodivisor, by its nonzero image in the integers. Apply the proved general isIso_reductionModIdeal_of_principalMilnorMorphism to these two Milnor triangles and the specified ordinary augmentation. Its tensor-product, successor-lift, boundary-square and coefficient-comparison argument gives precisely the requested isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_ordinary_augmentation_reduction (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W)]
    (O : DiagonalReductionPresentation ℓ (𝟭 (DiagonalAb W)))
    (RZ : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) ⥤ DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W))
    (ηZ : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) ⥤ DiagonalAb W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ RZ)
    (hRZ : RZ.IsRightDerivedFunctor ηZ
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DiagonalAb W) (.up ℤ)))
    (e : DiagonalAb W ≌
      Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology W) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)))
    [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (DiagonalAb W) ℤ)
    (hP : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), Mono (ℓ ^ (n + 1) • 𝟙 (P.X i))) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategory.reductionModIdeal (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (Ideal.span {(ℓ : ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)})).map
        (e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.map
          (integralStrictOrdinaryAugmentation ℓ RZ ηZ O P)))
